title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Maybe it’s because I’m white and don’t fully understand, but I feel like you can protest without setting fire to anything.
Me too, I’m not a violent person and I have never been angry or drunk enough to do something like that
But, I will say, I’m not black
And like, they gotta stop killing black people
Especially in that fashion. That was way worse than a video of a black guy getting shot jogging through a neighborhood ... which happened like two weeks ago
Right. That video was one of the hardest to watch. Again though, there are other ways to protest a grotesque murder than setting fire to buildings.
Doesn’t help the president just tweeted we should be shooting protestors.
He continues to pour fuel on the fire, like what’s gonna happen if this spreads
So much tension because of that already

Exactly. Even if he lied and said things that condemned racial violence and retaliatory violence of any kind like most politicians do, that would at least be better. I’d rather we all yelled about how he’s a liar than see people shot in the streets
Olivia culpo is hotter than Brooke fletcher
